purpose: A connected rinsing, drying and cloth-finishing yard that extends the east-bank weaving household into a legible production sequence.
hero: open three-bay finishing hall seen through the west gate

circulation.primary: east water street -> 1.64 m gate -> stone court -> open finishing hall
circulation.production: weaving veranda -> rinsing trough -> drain -> drying frames -> finishing table
circulation.primary_arrival_exception: The 1.64 m gate is a domestic work-yard entrance rather than a public hall. It exceeds the project 1.20 m minimum and terminates at a visible open hall.

structure: overlapped land support and continuous stone water street
thick split west wall with a real gate and solid roof
six hall columns on six stone shoes with longitudinal and transverse beams
solidified gabled hall roof with continuous ridge
six drying-frame columns on six shoes and two cross rails
